text:
maya (CS): Quick async check-in for LumenEdge onboarding + renewal handback. What I did: triaged webhook failures yesterday, pulled logs and attached a sample to the ticket. Saw repeated 429s and a couple of 401s. Engaged @ryan.
ryan (Eng): thanks — can you paste the exact error snippet? I can look at the proxy/ratelimit side.
maya (CS): log excerpt: ```2026-03-10T22:14:03Z ERROR request failed status=429 x-request-id=ce3f``` Also found `signature invalid` for one callback attempt. PR #412 is open to add retries + signature validation fix.
ryan (Eng): OK I can review PR #412 today, ETA midday. If it's just retry + small validation change I can approve and coordinate rollout. What are the customer SLA expectations?
maya (CS): Renewal call is Fri EOD; customer expects stable delivery for their staging replay which spiked to ~35 rps (docs show 10 rps). We want to be confident before handback.
sanjay (SRE): share source IPs and I'll whitelist them temporarily on staging while we validate. Also will watch token bucket stats.
maya (CS): sending IPs in DM. Also flag: customer rotated callback signing keys last week but didn't update the config — could explain the 401s.
ashley (Acct): FYI — for the renewal call I need a concise root cause + mitigation summary. If we need more time I can ask the customer to reschedule.
ryan (Eng): question — who manages the signing key rotation? If keys differ between customer and staging, signature checks will fail.
maya (CS): keys are customer-managed; I opened a quick Jira with the steps they need to update the callback secret in staging.
alex (PM): If PR merges, can we do a 5% canary rollout in staging, monitor 401/429 metrics, then ramp? Also add a short-lived telemetry counter for signature failures.
ryan (Eng): yes — will add a metric `webhook.signature_failures` and gate the rollout with a feature flag.
sanjay (SRE): temp whitelist applied until 1739062000 UTC. I'll watch for anomalies and post any deviations. :thumbsup:
maya (CS): current blockers: need ryan to review PR #412, need deploy + canary telemetry, and confirmation SRE whitelist didn't mask underlying problem. Today: ryan reviews PR, alex drafts canary steps, i'll finish renewal summary for customer.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: PR #412 -> staging at 2026-03-11T13:30Z (canary: 5%).
ryan (Eng): reviewing now, will ping when review is done.
maya (CS): thanks — tagging @ashley so renewal doc has the latest.
ashley (Acct): got it, will wait for final wording before sending the customer update.
maya (CS): end of async.
